author: ProfessorUtonium
body:
Hey Guys. Edans here with some Map Updates on a couple of important matter/FAQ. This is to clear up a couple of things and address a new Acceptance system of Maps.

How Map Acceptance and Denials work from now on:

After your map is submitted, You need to wait 1 week until you get an official response from a Map Developer. Don't expect to get a map accepted 1 week later though. It may take many weeks until we gather necessary information and the MapDevelopers voting if your map is going to be tested or not. This is to ensure that your map release has enough comments and suggestions about the map and what to do from map developers or users. If your map is denied, You will see an X on your title. If you see it accepted, you will see a checkbox on it. When your map gets denied, you will see what's wrong with the map from the mapdeveloper who commented on it. This will help you in editing the map for another submission to the mapdevs. Remember, if your map was denied, you can always resubmit it once you fix all the issues on it :).


A map accepted will be soon added into the repo for testing and testing will be done when a map developer and the map creator is online. The map creator must spectate the match with the map developer for the map developer to mention flaws in the map.

What makes a good map?
Every map should be unique from the others. We want maps that are different from the rest. Not 1000000 Quintus Style maps. We don't need those. We want maps that are different from all the maps we have. They COULD relate but it would be better if they are unique and by them self. A map could be accepted if it looked like a Throwback map IF the map is special and has different gameplay/style to the map. Remember, Be creative about your maps. Don't try to think that all maps will be accepted because they look like a map already in rots :P Make your map creative and think outside of the box. Some more good suggestions are to be unique with blocks. Don't only use stoneblocks but instead, mix around with block colors and create a unique block palette that can help you build. If you are always unsure how a map looks, contact a map developer and they will always assist you when they can :) Try to mix around with Gamemodes. Remember that we have other gamemodes and not just DTM!


A Couple of Things to Mention:

  1. If you currently have a map that has NEVER gotten an official response from a Map Developer, You may bump it up so you can resubmit it for map developers to view. If your map was denied a while back, you need to update it and fix the problems the map developers stated before submitting it back for another response.
  2. Make sure to use the “Map Making” subsection wisely! This is where you can show off your maps in progress for additional comments about the map. Map Releases is when you are confident about the map for submission to the map devs. Map Making is for your map before submission which I highly suggest you use!
Any Questions? Ask below vvvvvvvvvvvvvv

My skype is sethskye if any of you have any other questions.

- Edans
